title: Formulation Scientist
description:
Position Summary


The role will provide technical support for local laboratory work, with a primary focus on formulation development to support customer projects, the promotion of Vantage™ products, and customer events. Responsibilities include preparing reports and applying Vantage™ raw materials in formulations, with the goal of providing practical tools for the sales force and supporting strategic customers in the region.


The Research Scientist – Formulation & Application will be a science-driven project leader, responsible for planning, managing, supporting, and executing formulation and product development projects in LATAM, with a special emphasis on Brazil. This role will work closely with global R&D and Marketing teams, ideating, identifying, and developing new products for market launch, contributing to the growth of Vantage Personal Care in LATAM and globally.


Key responsibilities include developing formulations for major customers and evaluating their performance to demonstrate the benefits of our technologies, developing new personal care applications, and creating market-relevant concepts that promote Vantage™ technologies through marketing campaigns, customer events, trade shows, and industry activities. In addition, this role will design and perform (or coordinate) the necessary

performance tests to demonstrate and reinforce the value proposition of Vantage™ technologies.


Position Scope


The position will be located in Brasil.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


· Development of new formulations to highlight ingredients from Vantage portfolio and their added values in formulation (skin care, hair care, makeup, and toiletries applications) according to internal and external needs, such as Marketing campaigns, trade shows, customers events and needs etc.

· Support in tests for performance studies and sensorial tests for costumer projects.

· Contribute to new product development projects to improve VPC product portfolio, including discovering new products based on market trends and customers feedback, assessing technical feasibility, developing the new product, designing and conducting needed performance tests to improve the product design, and finalizing product specs, etc.

· Monitor stability testing of formulations: organoleptic and physicochemical analyses.

· Qualification of Vantage ingredients and issue the report with the results.

· Ensure the efficient operation of the laboratory (respect for SOPs, raw materials and packaging inventory management…).

· Use knowledge of routine laboratory safety procedures, SDS’s and interpretations of hazards/toxicity data to perform all laboratory work in accordance with the written safety manual and site safety policies.

· Be a steward for safety and continually drive awareness to ensure a safe work environment for all employees.

· Understand formulation procedures and technologies and incorporate this understanding into applications that add value to customer products.

· Maintain accurate records of all laboratory work and research in accordance with generally accepted laboratory principles.

· Manage the calibration and maintenance of laboratory equipment.


Note: The duties listed above are not all inclusive and may be subject to periodic updating or revision.


Education & Experience:


Education: Bachelor of Chemistry, Pharmacobiology, Cosmetics Technology, Pharmacy or related areas, linked to sciences (Chemistry).


Experience: between 5 to 8 years’ working experience in the cosmetics and chemical industry.




Knowledge, Skills, & Talents


· Spanish and English speaker.

· Knowledge of development Personal Care products (Formulation & process).

· Being responsible, organized, proactive, problem-solving, easy to work in a team are characteristics inherent to the vacancy profile

· Ability to apply logical and scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

· Ability to influence and work in cross functional teams.

· Excellent communication skills (oral and written) and interpersonal skills.

· Natural collaborator, contributing to a positive team dynamic.

· Continuous improvement mindset, always seeking opportunities to optimize processes.

title: Head of Finance, Brazil
description:
CONMED Corporation is a progressive, global medical device company, operating in 20 countries . Through thoughtful leadership, innovation and teamwork, we are changing the future of healthcare. Our 3,500 employees worldwide make meaningful contributions, positively impact the business, and advance in their careers as our company and product portfolio grows.


We are a leader in Orthopedics, General Surgery, Gynecology, Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Anesthesiology and our employees enjoy challenging and diverse job opportunities across these varied specializations. CONMED is headquartered in the United States. Our international presence includes more than 20 locations throughout Canada, Europe, Australia, Latin America, Asia, North America, and the Middle East.


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Finance Director for Brazil is responsible for leading all financial operations, ensuring full compliance with local regulations, strengthening internal controls, optimizing financial performance, developing and supporting strategic business objectives. This role is pivotal in elevating governance, audit readiness, and operational discipline across the Brazilian organization.


This role oversees FP&A, Controllership, Reporting, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Internal Controls, Compliance, and Financial Governance, while partnering closely with the Country Manager and regional/global Finance leadership to drive sustainable growth, profitability, strong governance and disciplined execution.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic & Financial Leadership

  • Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with corporate objectives and Brazil’s dynamic economic and regulatory environment.
  • Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, cash planning, and long-range planning processes for Brazil.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Country Manager and senior leadership team, providing actionable insights to influence commercial, operational, and organizational decisions.
  • Monitor market trends, FX volatility, reimbursement dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitor behavior to inform financial strategy.


Financial Reporting, Compliance & Audit Readiness

  • Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely reporting under Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate accounting standards (including US GAAP, if applicable).
  • Ensure complete, timely, and compliant statutory reporting, tax filings, SPED obligations (ECD/ECF), and other regulatory submissions.
  • Lead the Brazil Audit Remediation Plan, ensuring closure of all audit findings (high/medium/low risk) within established timelines.
  • Strengthen governance, documentation discipline, and financial process transparency to achieve “audit-ready, always” standards.
  • Manage external relationships with auditors (Big 4), tax authorities, banks, and regulatory bodies, representing the company with professionalism and financial rigor.


Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

  • Own end-to-end cash flow, liquidity planning, and working capital performance (AR, AP, inventory).
  • Lead banking relationships, credit facility management, financial instruments, FX operations, and covenant monitoring.
  • Optimize capital structure, credit utilization, hedging strategies, and funding needs in alignment with corporate Treasury.
  • Drive improvements in collections, DSO, inventory turns, and payment terms to enhance cash generation.


Performance Management & Business Partnering

  • Deliver comprehensive financial analysis, including P&L performance, balance sheet quality, KPI trends, pricing, and margin enhancement opportunities.
  • Evaluate commercial strategies, business cases, investments, and distributor economics across franchises, customers, and Brazil geographies.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to improve pricing governance, cost-to-serve, product mix optimization, and portfolio profitability


Internal Controls, Governance & Risk Management

  • Design, implement, and continuously strengthen internal controls aligned with SOX, corporate governance frameworks, and Brazilian regulatory requirements.
  • Lead governance of Fixed-asset tracking and mobility controls, Inventory accuracy, reconciliations, and reporting reliability (including 3PL and distributor consignment)
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive risk register, governance cadence, and audit calendar.


Systems, ERP & Digital Finance

  • Lead optimization and governance of ERP and reporting systems, improving data integrity, and reporting accuracy.
  • Implement analytics and BI tools to enhance management dashboards, forecasting, and business decision-making.


Team Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Finance organization across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Controls.
  • Build strong bench strength and raise capability in financial governance, technical accounting, tax, and analytics.
  • Lead the team through transformational change, strengthening culture, accountability, and execution discipline
  • Foster effective cross-functional partnerships with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Service teams.


QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  • Minimum 7–10 years in senior finance leadership roles (Finance Director, Country Controller, CFO, or equivalent) within multinational environments.
  • Proven experience in a similar leadership role or demonstrated potential to successfully assume such responsibilities.
  • Proven track record in governance turnarounds, internal controls design, and complex compliance environments.
  • Significant experience managing cash flow, working capital, treasury, and banking relationships.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Accounting, FP&A, Tax (including indirect taxes), Treasury, and statutory reporting.
  • Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or medical devices preferred; understanding of distributors and regulated markets is a plus.


Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of Brazil’s financial, tax, and regulatory landscape.
  • Strong command of Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate reporting frameworks including US GAAP
  • Advanced analytical thinking with ability to translate data into insights and influence senior decision-makers.
  • Strong systems orientation, with hands-on ERP experience (SAP/Oracle) and BI/reporting tools.
  • Exceptional communication skills in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive accountability, lead change, and elevate organizational capability.
  • High degree of integrity, assertiveness, discipline, and ownership in managing financial governance.


Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (required).
  • MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Controllership, or related field (preferred).
  • Professional certification such as CRC, CPA, CMA, or equivalent strongly preferred.
  • Additional credentials in internal controls, audit, or compliance are a plus.

title: Railway Electrical Engineer
description:
Are you looking to grow in a company where you can become a partner? Our core values are the Customer, the Individual, and Professional Development. If this sounds like you, keep reading!


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY


We are looking to hire a Railway Electrical Engineer to join our Rail team in Spain.


The selected candidate will be responsible for providing technical leadership in the design of airfields for large-scale international airport projects.

At IDOM, we offer you the opportunity to develop your professional career by actively participating in national and international projects that will challenge you to improve every day, in a collaborative and team-oriented environment. You will join a multidisciplinary group where you will play a key role in project development. You will gain a global perspective on different businesses and technologies in a flexible and trusting work environment.

If you join IDOM, you will find:


  • Flexible working hours
  • Teleworking 1 day a week or 2 afternoons
  • Intensive summer working hours (July and August)
  • Flexible remuneration (restaurant card, health insurance, transport card, childcare, etc.)
  • Life and accident insurance
  • Work-life balance
  • Commitment to long-term professional careers
  • Access to home ownership for all
  • Multicultural and multidisciplinary environment
  • Favorable attitude towards delegation, beyond the usual
  • Mutual commitment
  • Interpersonal relationships that promote unity


ABOUT YOU


Don't hesitate to apply if...


  • You preferably have a degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • You have 5 years of proven experience in railway environments (high speed, metro, tram, etc.). Experience in railway electrification projects in both direct current (DC) and alternating current (AC) is also required, as well as experience in the design, review, and validation of grounding and equipotentiality schemes. The ability to work in multidisciplinary and international environments will be valued.
  • You have in-depth knowledge of stray currents and their mitigation.
  • You are proficient in key European regulations for the railway sector, including EN 50122 (electrical safety and grounding), EN 50121 (electromagnetic compatibility), EN 50119 (catenary), and are familiar with other relevant standards (IEC, EN, etc.).
  • You have the ability to analyze electrical risks, grounding systems, and stray currents, as well as to prepare technical reports, procedures, mitigation strategies, etc.
  • You are fluent in English (minimum level B2/C1) (spoken and written); other languages will be valued.
  • You are a team player, autonomous, flexible, technically rigorous, and internationally minded.
  • And above all... you are eager to learn in an international company like IDOM


ABOUT US


IDOM is an association of professionals whose activity focuses on carrying out engineering, architecture, and consulting projects that contribute to a more sustainable world. The people at IDOM are

connected by our work and by our ownership of the firm, and we cooperate to achieve our greatest professional and personal development and the best service for our clients.

That is why IDOM's core asset is the value and experience of its people. Highly qualified professionals with strong human qualities, deeply united, who work in an environment of respect for their professional identity and freedom, with a strong ambition for progress, development, service, and innovation.

Since our founding in 1957, we have grown steadily and are now a multidisciplinary, integrated, international organization with a presence in 130 countries, where more than 4,300 people carry out our professional activities.


Are you ready to take the next step?

If you join our TEAM, you will be able to develop your career at the highest level, in an environment of deep trust and professional respect.


If you share our philosophy and want to be part of our company, send us your CV.


We want to meet you!

title: Senior Financial Controller
description:
Missão do Cargo

Garantir a integridade, precisão e conformidade das informações financeiras da empresa, assegurando controles internos robustos, eficiência operacional e suporte estratégico à alta liderança. O Senior Financial Controller atua como guardião da governança financeira, liderando processos críticos de contabilidade, controladoria, orçamento e compliance.

1. Contabilidade e Fechamentos Financeiros

  • Executar o ciclo completo de fechamento contábil mensal, trimestral e anual;
  • Garantir conformidade com normas contábeis (IFRS/local GAAP);
  • Preparar as demonstrações financeiras e notas explicativas;


2. Internal Control & Accounting Controls

  • Conduzir as auditorias internas e externas.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de políticas corporativas e regulatórias.
  • Conduzir o exercício de Control Self Assessment e implementar ações corretivas.


3. Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A)

  • - Liderar o processo de forecast e análises de variações.
  • - Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e projeções.
  • - Conduzir análises de cenários, rentabilidade e custos.


4. Suporte Estratégico ao Negócio

  • Atuar como parceiro financeiro das áreas de negócio.
  • Suportar iniciativas de crescimento e novos projetos.
  • Migração e Implementação de sistemas.


5. Reportes Corporativos

  • - Consolidar e reportar resultados à diretoria e matriz.
  • - Garantir precisão e pontualidade dos reportes.


Pré Requisitos do Cargo

Formação

  • - Graduação em Contabilidade, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • - Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças é um diferencial.

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • - Domínio de normas contábeis (IFRS/Local GAAP).
  • - Experiência com ERPs como TOTVS, SAP.
  • - Excel avançado e forte habilidade analítica.
  • - Desejável experiência com Power BI

Idiomas

  • - Inglês avançado

Experiência Prévia

  • 10/15 anos em controladoria ou áreas correlatas.
  • - Vivência em empresas multinacionais (kpmg, price)
  • - Experiência prévia em auditoria e controles internos é diferencial.

Competências Comportamentais

  • - Pensamento crítico e capacidade analítica.
  • - Comunicação clara e influente.
  • - Visão estratégica e foco em resultados.

Beneficios:

Plano de Saúde e Odontologico Sul America Especial 100 (10% de coparticipação)

VR/VA 55 ao dia

Estacionamento no Local

Hibrido (2x3 presencial ao escritorio)

Bonus Anual de 15%

title: Executivo de Contas Sênior em Farmer para Big Sellers - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre, trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferentes perspectivas. Isso se traduz em gênero, religião, pessoas com deficiência, LGBTQI+, etnia, gerações e diversidade de experiências. Trabalhamos todas as nossas vagas com base nessa premissa.

Estamos democratizando o comércio, o dinheiro e os pagamentos na América Latina.

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários (as).

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comércios, empreendimentos e profissões, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades das pessoas para as quais prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites;
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação;
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros;
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas;
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão;
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Promover excelência de relacionamento com uma carteira de clientes big sellers com alto faturamento mensal;
  • Acompanhar principais KPIs da carteira, tendo rotinas de análises sobre índices de chargeback, exposição ao risco, TPV mensal e diário, ticket médio, etc;
  • Promover upsell e cross-sell da carteira, construindo um pipeline consistente M+2;
  • Presencialidade nos sellers com foco em relacionamento com decisores conforme cluster definidos pela liderança;
  • Ownership de frentes táticas importantes para o desenvolvimento de engagement & growth com demais áreas pares;
  • Disponibilidade para vir ao escritório sempre que necessário (Melicidade).


Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação Superior Completa;
  • Possuir experiência em áreas comerciais e de negócios;
  • Possuir experiência no mercado financeiro, fintech e meios de pagamentos;
  • Possuir inglês avançado (escrita / conversação);
  • Possuir conhecimento analítico, será considerado como diferencial.


Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo;
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores;
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas;
  • Experimentar um excelente clima de trabalho, com o necessário para viver a grande experiência de trabalhar num lugar eleito, em diversas categorias, como Great Place to Work.


O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, descofie!

title: Analista GIS Sênior (ArcGIS) (Presencial São Paulo/SP)
description:
Vaga de atuação presencial no Cliente, localizado em São Paulo/SP.


Descrição da vaga

O profissional deverá suportar tecnicamente a equipe técnica do cliente, executando as atividades relacionadas a configuração, manutenção e melhor uso da plataforma ArcGIS, apresentadas a seguir:


• Instalação e configuração de softwares nativos plataforma ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro e Apps);

• Atualização de versão e configuração de softwares plataforma ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro e Apps);

• Administração dos dados armazenados nos Ambientes ArcGIS Enterprise e Online;

• Demonstrações de utilização da plataforma ArcGIS Enterprise, incluindo Apps; • prontas para uso (Survey123, Dashboard, etc.);

• Mentoring e acompanhamento dos usuários da plataforma ArcGIS;

• Explicação sobre a utilização de extensões;

• Publicação e gestão dos serviços de mapas no ArcGIS Enterprise ou ArcGIS Online;

• Publicação de geoprocessing no ArcGIS Enterprise;


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Prestar apoio no planejamento executivo dos projetos na aquisição, tratamento e gerenciamento de dados geoespaciais e alfanuméricos, realizando o levantamento de informações técnicas e analisando os insumos necessários com base em aspectos qualitativos e quantitativos;
  • Utilizar a edição de dados em geodatabase e criar modelos simples de geoprocessamento, criar, editar e explorar dados geográficos no ArcGIS Pro, criar layout simples de mapas e compartilhar mapas;
  • Utilizar as funcionalidades do ArcGIS, como ferramentas para visualizar, criar, gerenciar e analisar dados geográficos, aplicando os principais componentes e funcionalidades da Plataforma ArcGIS (Server, Mobile, Desktop, Online e extensões) e ter habilidade de identificar onde ela se aplica;
  • Utilizar ferramentas e funções do ArcGIS para criar fluxos de trabalho de SIG eficientes;
  • Realizar e aplicar modelagem de um geodatabase utilizando versionamento e elementos de rede e modelos complexos de geoprocessamento;
  • Aplicar a plataforma ArcGIS para realizar análise espaciais e ser capaz de automatizar processos;
  • Criar e aplicar elementos cartográficos dinâmicos e criar layout de mapas complexos;
  • Aplicar as funcionalidades do ArcGIS e ter habilidades avançadas para aplicar as ferramentas na visualização, criação, gerenciamento e análise de dados geográficos;
  • Aplicar o uso de geotecnologia nas diversas áreas de negócios verticais de atuação da Imagem;
  • Propor a escala de trabalho adequada para a solução de diferentes problemas geográficos;
  • Resolver problemas de distorções e compreender características específicas de dados geográficos, cuja origem esteja relacionada com a fonte;
  • Ter domínio das funcionalidades do ArcGIS e propor melhorias na utilização das ferramentas para visualizar, criar, gerenciar e analisar dados geográficos e auxiliar a equipe;
  • Propor melhorias no uso das ferramentas e funções do ArcGIS para criar fluxos de trabalho de SIG eficientes;
  • Domínio das principais extensões do ArcGIS e propor utilizações inovadoras na utilização das principais extensões;
  • Criar e estruturar novas metodologias de execução de serviços de geoprocessamento, estimativas e controle de qualidade conforme as características específicas a serem executadas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimentos avançados em GIS;
  • Conhecimentos das soluções e produtos ESRI (ArcGIS Pro e Apps, ArcGIS Enterprise e ArcGIS Online);
  • Compreensão referente a origem e conceitos básicos das tecnologias e metodologias para aquisição de dados geográficos;
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de projeção (UTM, Lambert) e datums geográficos (WGS84, SIRGAS2000);
  • Conhecimento dos principais padrões de metadados existentes.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Conhecimento de CAD;
  • Conhecimento de softwares de PDI;
  • Conhecimento em Sensoriamento Remoto, Geodésia, Cartografia, Análise Espacial, SIG’s e GIS Web;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.



Informações adicionais

description:

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on HR Business Partner based in Brazil to support our fast-growing local team.

This role is highly execution-focused, with a strong emphasis on recruitment (50%) , while also covering employee relations & compliance, culture building, and basic office administration.

You will work closely with local business leaders and our global HQ, acting as a trusted partner who can move fast, get things done, and grow with the business .

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition (50%)

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for the Brazil team, including roles in operations, live streaming hosts, business development, and support functions
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand business needs and deliver high-quality hires quickly
  • Manage and optimize local recruiting channels (LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, agencies, communities, etc.)
  • Screen, interview, and assess candidates with a strong focus on role fit and potential
  • Track hiring progress and continuously improve recruiting efficiency and candidate experience

Employee Relations & Compliance (25%)

  • Manage employee relations and ensure compliance with Brazilian labor laws and regulations
  • Handle employment contracts, probation periods, terminations, and disciplinary matters
  • Coordinate with external vendors such as payroll providers, accounting firms, and labor lawyers
  • Serve as the first point of contact for employees on HR-related questions and issues
  • Proactively identify and communicate labor risks and compliance updates to HQ

Culture & Organizational Support (15%)

  • Support the localization and implementation of company culture within the Brazil team
  • Drive onboarding, employee engagement, and internal communication initiatives
  • Support people managers with basic people management and cross-cultural collaboration
  • Act as a cultural bridge between the Brazil team and global stakeholders

Administration & Office Support (10%)

  • Support basic office administration and local operational needs
  • Coordinate vendors and ensure a smooth day-to-day office environment
  • Provide flexible support as the business continues to scale

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in HR, preferably in an HRBP or generalist role
  • Strong hands-on experience in recruitment; able to manage multiple roles independently
  • Solid understanding of or strong interest in Brazilian labor law and HR compliance
  • Fluent in Portuguese; working proficiency in English (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
  • Highly adaptable, proactive, and comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Practical, down-to-earth, and willing to roll up sleeves to get things done

What We Offer

  • A fast-growing business with strong momentum and real impact
  • High level of ownership and autonomy in the HR function
  • Close collaboration with senior leadership and global teams
  • Long-term career growth opportunities as the business expands

title: Consultor de franquias
description:
Somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol. Formada em 2018 pela combinação da Essilor e da Luxottica, nossa empresa combina dois séculos de inovação e esforço humano para elevar o cuidado com a visão e a experiência do consumidor ao seu redor.

Somos o lar das marcas de óculos e cuidados com a visão mais amadas e amplamente reconhecidas do mundo. Nossas marcas proprietárias de óculos incluem Ray-Ban, Oakley, Costa, Vogue Eyewear, Persol e Oliver Peoples, complementadas por mais de 20 marcas licenciadas de prestígio.

Nossas tecnologias avançadas de lentes incluem Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest e Transitions. Oferecemos experiências superiores de compras e pacientes com uma rede de 18.000 lojas, incluindo marcas de varejo de classe mundial como Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò e GrandVision.


Estamos em busca de um novo colaborador(a) para fazer parte da nossa equipe Comercial como Consultor de Franquias , em nossa base em Santa Catarina.


Descrição da vaga

Responsável pela execução das estratégias comerciais e operacionais na rede franqueada, atuando no abastecimento da rede e implantação de processos operacionais e de venda, visando atingimento dos resultados, crescimento de suas lojas, expansão de portfólio, bem como a manutenção dos padrões da marca a fim de elevar a exposição da marca e o nível de satisfação da rede e clientes com o negócio.

Atuar como consultor, expondo as melhores práticas da rede, bem como orientar o franqueado sobre a perfeita execução do ponto de venda, visando o crescimento do negócio e da marca Óticas Carol.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar o diagnóstico da operação do franqueado, avaliando mix, execução de VM, indicadores como faturamento, preço médio, CMV, resultado por categoria, marca e produto;
  • Avaliar a estrutura física das lojas (identidade visual, vitrine etc.), qualidade do atendimento, sistemas de TI e nível de serviço em geral;
  • Sinalizar para o franqueado gaps identificados e buscar reversão desses pontos e melhoria a curto prazo;
  • Manter e estreitar o relacionamento com os franqueados, gerentes e staff das lojas por meio da excelência no trabalho de consultoria e capacitação desses stakeholders;
  • Ser a interface entre o franqueado e demais unidades de negócio da franqueadora, visando minimizar conflitos, crescimento dos produtos estratégicos, alinhamento de conduta e execução dos guias estratégicos e de marca estabelecidos pela franqueadora;
  • Desenvolver plano de ação em conjunto com o franqueado para aumentar o faturamento da operação, influenciar e apoiar o franqueado na execução do mesmo, a fim de um negócio rentável e saudável;
  • Atuar na positivação, incremento de share e venda dos produtos estratégicos por meio de ferramentas de abastecimento e garantindo acompanhamento do início ao fim dos pedidos;
  • Ser o multiplicador na rede franqueada das estratégias comerciais e operacionais da franqueadora, auxiliando no crescimento de market share de produtos e fornecedores estratégicos, seja através da implantação e desenvolvimento de novos produtos/categorias no ponto de venda ou treinamentos de stakeholders para melhor execução.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Economia ou áreas afins;
  • Vivência na dinâmica de varejo e gestão de rede de franquias;
  • Disponibilidade de viagens;
  • Conhecimento no segmento Ótico ou de franquias (diferencial).


A EssilorLuxottica valoriza e apoia a diversidade, por esse motivo, todas as nossas vagas são abertas para candidaturas de profissionais PCDs.

Faça parte da nossa empresa e ajude a projetar o futuro da saúde visual.

title: GERENTE DE MIX E VAREJO
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Fortalecer a área como um pilar estratégico dentro do Grupo Iguatemi, consolidando sua posição como uma das referências formais em inovação.

Garantir o NOI dos shoppings e o EBITDA corporativo por meio de uma curadoria assertiva de lojas e marcas para todos os malls e para o Iguatemi 365, orientando as decisões a partir dos quatro pilares da área: inteligência, inovação, planejamento e relacionamento.


RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

Fazer o planejamento anual dos shoppings para definição das prioridades estratégicas (principais oportunidades e desafios), diagnóstico do mix ideal de lojas, mapeamento de marcas (considerando posicionamento, faixa etária e estilo) e vocação, sempre alinhadas com as principais tendências globais e que possuem sinergia com o nosso negócio;

Desenvolver operações exclusivas para os shoppings do grupo e garantir o diferencial e melhor experiência para o consumidor, além da integridade dos corredores estratégicos, áreas que definem a identidade e posicionamento de cada shopping representando parte dos atributos que compõem e reforçam a marca Iguatemi;

Desenvolver estudos de grupos econômicos para analisar presença geográfica das marcas, verificar oportunidades em nossos malls, possíveis parcerias com outros empreendedores, infrações cometidas, além de mapear pleitos e concessões;

Desenvolvimento de agenda estratégica de grupos econômicos com o objetivo de formar negociações e repassar decisões para equipe comercial elaborar propostas. Além disso, a gerência é responsável por definir também as estratégicas de expansão dos lojistas considerando as informações do acompanhamento da performance de vendas e visitas mensais à concorrência.

Garantir o atingimento do NOI / receita dos seus shoppings através da efetividade das iniciativas propostas no PIX e desdobradas no 5YP e 3YP com trocas de lojas efetivas (sales spread positivo), participação ativa no orçamento anual dos shoppings, curva de entrada e saída de lojas, definição de allowance e expectativa de vendas.

Garantir o atingimento trimestral em ABL por shopping projetado no pipeline de assinaturas e acompanhar a taxa de ocupação divulgada para o mercado, além de fazer a gestão do plano de ação para locação das áreas por meio de contrato de leasing/mídia semanalmente em recop e garantir a abertura da operação para que não ocorra impacto negativo na receita líquida.

Analisar as pesquisas por categoria do share (faturamento) que cada um dos shoppings ocupa em relação aos seus concorrentes diretos, oportunidade de crescimento do ticket médio e perfil dos clientes por renda, para a melhor tomada de decisão na estratégia de fortalecimento das categorias com marcas fortes que seja atrativo para o cliente alvo.

Avaliar a exposição em ABL, receita e vendas para marcas internacionais nos shoppings únicos (Iguatemi São Paulo, JK e Brasília) e garantir o melhor equilibrio nos contratos comerciais.

Definir vocação, mix ideal e planejar as lojas por categoria e segmento dos greenfields e expansões, além de elaborar junto com a arquitetura e engenharia as plantas e acompanhar / comercializar as lojas junto com a área comercial.

Realizar reuniões frequentes (aquecimento de lead) com lojistas para garantir gestão do portfólio e melhores negociações comerciais (leasing spread positivo, coparticipação, exclusividade, etc).

Realizar a curadoria de marcas para o Iguatemi 365 e garantir equilíbrio no mix de produtos dentro de suas categorias.


OBSERVAÇÕES

Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Marketing, Moda, Comunicação, Engenharia, Design.

Pós Graduação em Marketing, Moda, Varejo (diferencial)

description:

Descrição da vaga


Como Analista de Educação Corporativa você irá atuar como protagonista na evolução da educação corporativa, desenhando jornadas de aprendizagem estratégicas, orientadas por dados e potencializadas por Inteligência Artificial. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Administrar plataformas de aprendizagem (LMS/LXP), garantindo usabilidade, engajamento, governança e evolução funcional.
  • Aplicar Inteligência Artificial generativa e preditiva para personalização de trilhas, recomendação de conteúdos e automação de processos educacionais.
  • Realizar a gestão e curadoria de conteúdos digitais com base em dados de consumo, performance e métricas de aprendizagem.
  • Implementar novos processos, metodologias e parcerias educacionais, incluindo a homologação e gestão de fornecedores.
  • Atuar na gestão de stakeholders, articulando-se com áreas de negócio, tecnologia e RH para garantir alinhamento e efetividade das soluções educacionais.
  • Oferecer suporte técnico e feedback contínuo aos multiplicadores do conhecimento, estimulando a criação e disseminação de novos conteúdos.
  • Orientar tecnicamente analistas de níveis anteriores, promovendo alinhamentos, padronização de processos e desenvolvimento do time.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de análise de dados (Google Workspace, Power BI, Excel, Looker Studio) para acompanhamento de indicadores e geração de insights.
  • Atuar com metodologias ágeis na condução de projetos educacionais, garantindo organização, priorização e entregas de valor.


Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


  • Formação superior completa em áreas como Pedagogia, Psicologia, Administração, Tecnologia Educacional, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência de Dados ou correlatas.
  • Vivência em Educação Corporativa ou Treinamento & Desenvolvimento, com atuação no desenho de trilhas de aprendizagem e jornadas de desenvolvimento digitais, presenciais ou híbridas.
  • Experiência prática com dados de aprendizagem, learning analytics e uso de indicadores para apoiar decisões estratégicas em T&D.
  • Conhecimento em design instrucional, arquitetura de jornadas de aprendizagem e experiência do colaborador.
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas LMS/LXP e gestão da experiência do usuário.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de dados como Power BI, Excel, Google Workspace e Looker Studio.
  • Interesse e prática no uso de Inteligência Artificial (generativa e preditiva) aplicada à educação, personalização de trilhas e automação de processos.


Requisitos desejáveis

SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Coordenar a entrega de serviços para clientes do segmento PME.
  • Gerenciar relacionamento e expectativas dos clientes, assegurando satisfação e fidelização.
  • Capacitar a força de vendas sobre produtos, processos e soluções de telecomunicações.
  • Elaborar desenho de soluções de telecomunicações alinhadas às necessidades dos clientes.


O que esperamos de você?

  • Pensa e age a partir das perspectivas dos clientes. Demonstra interesse e curiosidade de conhecer os clientes, seus comportamentos e preferências para atender e superar suas expectativas;
  • Demonstra compromisso permanente em aprender, ensinar e desenvolver, contribuindo para um ambiente descontraído, respeitoso e colaborativo, incentivando a diversidade;
  • É flexível para se desprender de paradigmas e modelos mentais existentes. Busca soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis, para criar vantagens competitivas para o negócio, equilibrando os interesses econômicos, ambientais e sociais.


Pré-requisitos (eliminatórios):

  • Graduação Superior Completa em Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Telecomunicações ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimentos em Redes IP, Formação de Redes, serviços em nuvem, segurança, Telefonia móvel, IOT, etc
  • Experiência comprovada em redes de telecomunicações (dados/voz/Soluções Digitais).
  • Conhecimento em gerenciamento de projetos
  • Habilidade em desenho de soluções e consultoria técnica/comercial.
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de negociação e orientação para resultados.


É diferencial:

  • Experiência na área comercial;
  • Certificações em redes (Cisco, Juniper, ITIL, PMP etc.).
  • Experiência com Soluções de Telecomunicações


E por que a escolher a Claro?

Na Claro, pessoas é um dos nossos valores. Com este pensamento, investimos sempre no cuidado com a saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida dos nossos colaboradores!

Para que você tenha a melhor experiência em sua jornada com a gente, oferecemos um atraente pacote de benefícios. Veja só:

  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Meu Pet Club
  • Convênios e Parcerias;
  • Programa de Reconhecimento por tempo de casa;
  • E muito mais!


Na nossa empresa, valorizamos um ambiente inclusivo, diverso, ético, colaborativo e harmônico. Não fazemos distinção de gênero, raça, cor, orientação sexual, posição social ou deficiências. Todos e todas são bem-vindos(as)!

Somos a Forvis Mazars, com mais de 80 anos de expertise global e mais de 20 anos de presença no Brasil. Presente em mais de 100 países, nossos colaboradores estão a postos para apoiar sua empresa com serviços de Auditoria, Consultoria e BPO reconhecidos pelo mercado no Brasil e no mundo.


Como é atuar conosco


Por meio da nossa área de Alocação de Talentos, você poderá colocar sua experiência em prática em contextos empresariais variados, contribuindo com nosso padrão de excelência em distintas operações e segmentos.


Ao ser alocado em uma de nossas demandas externas, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, colaborando diretamente para o sucesso de nossos clientes. Essa contribuição proporciona vivência prática e aprendizado constante. E, você contará com o acompanhamento próximo da equipe Forvis Mazars, garantindo alinhamento ao longo de toda a sua atuação.



Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Apoiar nos processos de apuração dos tributos diretos (IRPJ, CSLL) e indiretos (ICMS, IPI, ISS, PIS, COFINS), realizando lançamentos e conferências sob supervisão.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração e entrega das obrigações acessórias (como EFD-Contribuições, EFD-ICMS/IPI, DCTF, REINF), garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos legais.
  • Realizar conciliações fiscais e auxiliar na identificação de eventuais divergências entre os dados contábeis e fiscais.
  • Acompanhar atualizações básicas da legislação tributária e repassar informações relevantes à equipe quando necessário.
  • Dar suporte no atendimento a fiscalizações e auditorias, organizando documentos e relatórios solicitados.
  • Contribuir com a organização e melhoria das rotinas fiscais, propondo ajustes simples em processos manuais ou operacionais.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de planilhas e relatórios gerenciais para acompanhamento de obrigações e indicadores da área.


Requisitos / Qualificações


  • Formação: Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • CRC ativo desejável.
  • Experiência: Vivência de 3–5 anos na área fiscal/tributária, com apuração de impostos diretos e indiretos e entrega das principais obrigações acessórias.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos:
  • IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ICMS, IPI, ISS e retenções (IRRF, INSS, PCC).
  • SPED Fiscal, ECD, ECF, EFD Contribuições, DCTF, DIRF e REINF.
  • Legislação tributária vigente e regimes de apuração (Lucro Real e Presumido).
  • Ferramentas: ERP (SAP, Oracle, TOTVS ou similar) e Excel avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, PROC-, Power Query). Power BI será diferencial.


O que esperamos de você


  • Comprometimento com prazos, entregas e qualidade do trabalho;
  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes ambientes e rotinas corporativas;
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas e execução das atividades;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Responsabilidade, organização e adaptabilidade;
  • Disposição para colaborar com diferentes equipes e projetos;


Benefícios


  • Rede de academias;
  • Canal de apoio psicológico;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Accounts Receivable Assistant
description:
Job Title: Assistant – Accounts Receivable

Department: Finance

Reporting To: Manager – Finance

Direct Reports: N/A

Location- Santos, Brazil


Job Purpose:

The Assistant – Accounts Receivable is responsible for supporting day-to-day accounts receivable operations, including invoicing, receipting, customer ledger maintenance, collections follow-up, and reconciliations. The role ensures accuracy of receivable records, timely collections, compliance with company policies and Brazilian statutory requirements, and contributes to healthy cash flow and financial discipline.


Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

Accounts Receivable Operations

  • Prepare and issue customer invoices accurately and on time based on operational and contractual data.
  • Record customer receipts, adjustments, credit notes, and settlements in the accounting system.
  • Maintain and update customer accounts receivable ledgers on a regular basis.
  • Follow up with customers on outstanding balances to support timely collections.
  • Maintain organized supporting documents for all AR transactions.


Reconciliations and Reporting

  • Assist in reconciling customer accounts and resolving billing or payment discrepancies.
  • Support preparation of accounts receivable aging reports and collection status reports.
  • Assist in month-end closing activities related to accounts receivable.
  • Verify accuracy of billing data and ensure alignment with contracts and operational records.
  • Support audit requirements by providing AR-related schedules and documentation.


Cash Flow and Collections

  • Track incoming payments and update collection status regularly.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to resolve disputes impacting collections.
  • Support cash flow monitoring by highlighting overdue balances and risks.
  • Maintain accurate records of advances, deposits, and unapplied receipts.


Compliance and Documentation

  • Ensure compliance with internal accounting controls and company policies.
  • Support compliance with Brazilian invoicing and financial documentation requirements.
  • Maintain AR documentation in an organized and audit-ready manner.


Team and Administrative Support

  • Coordinate with Operations, Customer Service, and Commercial teams for billing clarifications.
  • Respond to customer and internal queries related to invoices and payments.
  • Support the Manager – Finance & Accounts in improving AR processes and controls.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

• Accuracy of invoicing and customer ledger records – 25%

• Timely issuance of invoices and recording of receipts within agreed timelines – 25%

• Reduction in overdue receivables and improvement in collection cycle time – 20%

• Timely completion of AR reconciliations and month-end activities – 15%

• Compliance with internal controls, audit, and statutory requirements – 15%


Key Interactions:

Internal: Finance, Operations, Customer Service, Commercial

External: Customers, Banks, Auditors, Statutory Authorities (as required)


Core Competencies (Grade B – Support Level):

  • Integrity & Accountability: Maintains confidentiality and accuracy in receivable records.
  • Attention to Detail: Ensures precision in invoicing, receipting, and reconciliations.
  • Customer Focus: Communicates professionally with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Agility: Manages multiple receivables and deadlines efficiently.
  • Team Collaboration: Works closely with finance and operations teams to resolve issues.


Functional Competencies (Grade B – Support Level):

  • Accounts Receivable Management: Understanding of billing, collections, and customer ledgers.
  • Customer Reconciliation: Ability to reconcile accounts and resolve discrepancies.
  • Invoicing Accuracy: Ensures invoices are aligned with contracts and services rendered.
  • Compliance & Documentation: Maintains records for audit and statutory requirements.
  • ERP & Financial Systems: Basic proficiency in accounting systems (e.g., SAP, Tally, EBMS).
  • Numerical Accuracy: Ensures correctness in calculations and data entry.


Education and Experience Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, or related field.


Experience:

  • 1–2 years of experience in accounts receivable or finance operations.
  • Experience working with ERP or accounting systems preferred.
  • Basic understanding of invoicing, collections, and reconciliations.
  • Experience in shipping, logistics, or service industries is an advantage.
  • Portuguese – Fluent (required).
  • English – Working proficiency (preferred).


Work Environment and Specific Requirements:

  • Office-based role supporting daily accounts receivable operations.
  • Requires accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
  • May support month-end closings, audits, or collection drives requiring extended hours.
  • Reports directly to the Manager – Finance & Accounts for task allocation and performance review.

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Teltonika aspires to become one of the global leaders in providing unique IoT solutions that contribute to making people’s lives easier. Since 1998, we have gained considerable experience and competence in electronics development and production. Today, our areas of expertise include telematics, networking, telemedicine, EV charging, and electronics manufacturing. While proactively searching for new ideas and ways to create more value for our clients, we also hope to create a better future for our employees and the communities we operate in. Our organizational culture is based on mutual trust and respect as well as creating synergy with our employees and clients.


We are looking for an Accountant Analyst to join our team in São Paulo, Brazi l. This role is ideal for a professional with strong accounting expertise, hands-on experience with local compliance, and the ability to work autonomously while collaborating with global stakeholders.


In this role, you will:

  • Prepare and manage the main financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow).
  • Lead monthly and annual closings, including P&L reporting, in collaboration with the CFO
  • Maintain accurate general ledger records, journal entries, and supporting documentation
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting, tax, and statutory requirements
  • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable, including billing and reconciliations
  • Monitor cash flow and support foreign exchange operations
  • Support inventory control, monthly inventory audits, and reconciliation of assets and liabilities
  • Assist in budget preparation, financial forecasts, and variance analysis
  • Prepare financial reports for internal management and external stakeholders
  • Support internal and external audits
  • Contribute to process improvements related to accounting, importation, and financial controls


What we expect of you:

  • Good English skills (B1+, written and spoken)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field
  • At least 3 years of experience in accounting roles (mid-level or senior)
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian accounting and tax legislation
  • Experience with ERP systems and advanced Excel
  • High attention to detail, organization, and ownership mindset
  • Ability to work independently and manage deadlines
  • Nice to Have: Active CRC; Knowledge of financial routines such as cash flow, AP/AR, and budgeting; Experience in multinational or international environments; Familiarity with IFRS


What we offer:

  • Salary : We appreciate everyone's efforts and experiences, so we offer an attractive salary matching your skillset and field expertise.
  • Career : Great opportunities to grow in a strong and rapidly expanding company.
  • Work model: Hybrid (4 days in person and one remote)
  • Catering benefits: Cartão Caju (Vale Refeição of R$35 per working days + Saldo Livre of R$750 monthly + R$09 per working day), coffee and fruits provided in the office;
  • Health and Well-being Benefits: TotalPass, SESC membership, healthcare, dental care, and life insurance.
  • Teambuilding: regular office celebrations and events that help us to get to know each other better.
  • Caring and supportive team: we constantly seek for our employees to have better leadership while regularly sending our managers to external coaching sessions, conducting annual employee engagement surveys, and other management and HRD initiatives to help our employees overcome bottlenecks and challenges.


We will only contact selected candidates.

title: Analyst – Documentation
description:
Job Title: Analyst – Documentation

Department: Customer Service & Documentation

Reporting To: Manager – Customer Service and Documentation

Direct Reports: N/A


Job Purpose

The Documentation Analyst is responsible for the efficient handling import/export documentation, ensuring compliance with Brazilian Federal Revenue (RFB) regulations, supporting customers with document requirements, maintaining system integrity, and coordinating with ports, terminals, carriers, and stakeholders. The role ensures timely submissions, documentation accuracy, and professional interactions to support seamless cargo handling.


Main Tasks and Responsibilities

Customer Service & Documentation Handling

• Ensure shipping documentation accuracy including BL issuance, corrections, and approvals

• Respond to customer requests regarding BL, arrival, clearance, cargo information, and deadlines

• Support customers in submitting required guarantees (e.g., LOIs, letters, payments)

• Maintain communication with vessels, carriers, terminals, and agents


Regulatory Compliance & System Processing

• Update Carrier systems and internal agency systems

• Ensure BL updates, approvals, and registry details follow Carrier process and Brazilian Regulations as per RFB IN 800 deadlines

• Maintain correct data in Siscomex Carga, safeguarding the interest of the agency and carriers

• Support customers in submitting required guarantees (e.g., LOIs, letters, payments)

• Assist with process of cargo authorization and release document validation


Confidentiality & Compliance

• Ensure confidentiality of customer and company data

• Follow code of ethics, compliance, and data protection protocols

• Maintain audit-ready documentation standards


Team & Departmental Support

• Assist the Manager as required

• Maintain collaborative relationships with colleagues, service providers, and customers

• Promote a professional, efficient, and cooperative working environment


Key Interactions

Internal: Operations, Finance, Commercial

External: Customers, Agents, Carriers, Terminal Operators, Port Authorities


Core Competencies (Grade C – Professional Band)

• Integrity & Accountability - Ensures accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance in documentation activities

• Customer Focus – Provides reliable service and support to internal and external customers

• Continuous Learning – Understands documentation regulations and system updates

• Agility – Manages multiple shipments, deadlines, and last-minute changes effectively

• Collaboration & Communication – Works effectively with various stakeholders


Functional Competencies (Grade C – Professional Band)

• Regulatory Compliance – Knowledge of Brazilian customs requirements and manifest process

• Data Accuracy & Quality Control – Maintains high data integrity and timely document handling

• Customer Service Orientation – Maintains customer satisfaction through professional service

• ERP/Data System Proficiency – Uses digital systems for data entry and process control


Education and Experience Requirements

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Logistics, or related field


Experience:

• Minimum 2 years’ experience in documentation, shipping, or port regulatory processing

• Familiarity with Siscomex, Mercante/Siscarga, and Brazilian RFB processes

• Proficiency in MS Office and shipping/ERP tools

• English – Fluent; Portuguese - Fluent


Work Environment & Specific Requirements

• Office-based role with potential port or terminal document runs

• Requires high accuracy, attention to detail, and deadline discipline

• May require extended working hours during vessel cut-offs or peak operational periods

description:

A Phibro é uma empresa diversificada. Além de nutrição e saúde animal, fabricamos e comercializamos produtos para melhorar a performance na produção de etanol, microbianos para plantas, aplicações domésticas e industriais e especialidades químicas para vários mercados industriais.

title: Strategy and Planning Expert
description:
What You'll Do

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly strategic and analytical Strategy & Planning Expert to join our team and lead the business evolution of our Innovation vertical. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the business model, managing the end-to-end P&L, and serving as the Project Management Office (PMO) for key implementation projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of strategic vision, financial acumen, and operational process design skills to drive sustainable growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Model Evolution : Design and continuously evolve the business model for the Innovation vertical, including market entry strategies, new service offerings, and go-to-market approaches.
  • P&L Management : Own and manage the P&L for the vertical, including financial forecasting, budget planning, and variance analysis. Identify and execute initiatives to improve profitability and top-line growth.
  • Strategic Planning : Develop and lead the strategic planning process for the vertical, identifying market trends, competitive threats, and growth opportunities. Translate strategy into actionable, measurable plans.
  • PMO for Implementation : Serve as the Project Management Office for all strategic initiatives and key implementation projects within the vertical. Define project scope, manage timelines, track progress, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Process Design & Improvement : Design, map, and implement new business processes to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and performance. Conduct root cause analysis to identify process bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Product, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure alignment on strategy and execution.
  • Stakeholder Management : Communicate project updates, financial performance, and strategic direction to key stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Performance Analysis : Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure business model health, project success, and operational effectiveness.


What We Need From You

  • Education : Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly desirable.
  • Experience : Proven experience in a strategy, planning, business development, or management consulting role, with significant experience in P&L management and process design. Experience in the Food Delivery sector is a plus.
  • Strategic Acumen : Strong ability to think strategically, analyze complex business problems, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Analytical Skills : Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong financial modeling and forecasting skills.
  • Project Management : Expertise in project management methodologies and tools, with experience managing complex, cross-functional projects.
  • Process Design : Experience in mapping, designing, and optimizing business processes.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Leadership : A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to drive change in a fast-paced environment.

title: Field Representative
description:
Cargo: Representante de Dados de Campo

Tipo de Emprego: Regular, tempo integral. Segunda a sexta-feira

Localização: Brasil (Belo Horizonte)


Descrição do Trabalho:

A Aceolution está contratando com urgência Representantes de Dados de Campo no Brasil (Belo Horizonte) para verificar pontos de interesse (POI) com base em instruções específicas de pesquisa. Isso envolverá caminhar nos locais designados.

No entanto, os trabalhadores são livres para usar bicicleta/scooter/outro meio de transporte, se desejarem.

Verificação pedestre de POIs (Pontos de Interesse), que podem incluir hotéis, postos de gasolina, restaurantes e similares. Nós forneceremos:

O pesquisador precisará ir até o POI e verificar/coletar algumas informações que podem envolver de 5 a 10 parâmetros sobre ele e tirar uma foto da entrada. Recomendamos a coleta a pé; no entanto, os trabalhadores são livres para usar bicicleta/scooter/outro meio de transporte, se ele/ela desejar.


Requisitos:

  • Deve morar no Brasil (Belo Horizonte)
  • Proficiência em inglês (leitura e fala)
  • Capacidade de caminhar ou usar outros meios de transporte para verificação de POIs

title: Senior Logistics Specialist-First Mile
description:

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from a global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Requirements

● Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related fields.

● Minimum of 5 years in logistics operations in Brazil, preferably in e-commerce and/or express logistics.

● Operational Expertise: Strong understanding of first mile logistics, supplier coordination, and performance management.

● Data-Driven Mindset: Ability to analyze KPIs, identify risks, and drive process improvements through data insights.

● Hands-on Approach: Willingness to visit field operations, engage with sellers, and ensure seamless execution.

● Problem-Solving Skills: Quick analytical thinking to address operational challenges and implement preventive measures.

● Project Management: Experience in leading and executing logistics projects, working cross-functionally to achieve business goals.

● Mandatory fluency in Portuguese and English. Spanish and Mandarin are plus.

  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento da estrutura física do produto.

title: Executive - Equipment Control

Job Title: Executive – Equipment Control

Department: Operations

Reporting To: Manager – Operations

Direct Reports: N/A


Job Purpose:

The Executive – Equipment Control is responsible for overseeing container equipment inventory, ensuring effective coordination with depots and state agents, and maintaining accurate, real-time tracking of container movements. The role focuses on optimizing equipment utilization, planning asset allocation, resolving operational challenges, and supporting smooth logistics operations across Brazil and neighboring regions including Argentina, Uruguay, and Paraguay.


Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

Equipment Inventory Management & Planning

  • Maintain and update daily container equipment inventory statistics with high accuracy.
  • Monitor stock levels and prepare equipment allocation plans based on operational demand.
  • Analyze historical data and trends to optimize equipment availability and positioning.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure efficient equipment flow.


Depot & Vendor Coordination

  • Act as the primary liaison between container depots and state agents for equipment movements.
  • Coordinate with depot teams to track inbound and outbound container flows.
  • Resolve depot-related operational issues and monitor vendor performance to ensure service reliability.


Container Tracking & Documentation

  • Update and maintain container movement logs accurately in the tracking system.
  • Ensure data integrity and investigate discrepancies in equipment records.
  • Generate regular reports on equipment utilization, stock availability, and movement history.


Issue Resolution & Process Improvement

  • Identify and resolve equipment-related operational issues in a timely manner.
  • Work closely with Operations and Commercial teams to address inefficiencies in equipment allocation.
  • Propose process improvements to enhance tracking accuracy, turnaround time, and operational efficiency.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Maintain 100% accuracy in daily equipment inventory records, with discrepancies below 0.5% per quarter – 25%
  • Submit equipment allocation plans within 24 hours, achieving at least 95% alignment with operational demand – 20%
  • Ensure 98% on-time execution of equipment movements with minimal escalations – 20%
  • Resolve 95% of reported equipment-related issues within 24 hours – 15%
  • Ensure 100% real-time container movement updates with zero data gaps – 20%


Key Interactions:

Internal: Finance, HR & Admin, Operations, Procurement, Commercial

External: Vendors, Banks, Auditors, Statutory Authorities



Education and Experience Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Maritime Studies, Logistics, or related field
  • Specialization in Supply Chain Management, Maritime Operations, or Business Management
  • Master’s degree is preferred


Certifications & Training:

  • Professional certifications in Supply Chain Management, Maritime Operations, or Logistics (preferred)
  • Training in equipment flow optimization, compliance, and data management


Language Requirements:

  • English – Fluent
  • Portuguese – Required
  • Spanish – Optional / Advantage


Background and Experience:

Work Experience:

  • Industry: Shipping, Logistics, Freight Forwarding
  • Role Exposure: Equipment Management, Fleet Control, Logistics Coordination
  • Experience Range: 4–6 years


Core Competencies (Level 1 – Grades A–D):

  • Integrity & Accountability – Organizes work effectively, prioritizes tasks, and takes ownership of responsibilities
  • Customer Focus – Understands customer needs and ensures service delivery meets expectations
  • Continuous Learning – Actively seeks feedback, training, and applies new knowledge
  • Collaboration & Communication – Communicates clearly and supports teamwork proactively
  • Agility – Adapts to change and manages evolving operational priorities effectively


Functional Competencies:

  • Equipment Control & Management – Expertise in container inventory, allocation, and equipment flow
  • Logistics Coordination – Strong understanding of equipment movement within shipping operations
  • Data Analysis & Reporting – Ability to generate and interpret utilization and stock reports
  • Regulatory Compliance – Knowledge of industry regulations related to equipment control
  • Technology & Automation – Experience with equipment tracking systems and inventory tools


Work Environment & Specific Requirements:

  • Office-based role with regular coordination with depots, terminals, and vendors
  • Occasional travel to depots and equipment facilities as required
  • Requires strong attention to detail, coordination skills, and operational discipline

title: Senior Executive – Demurrage & Detention
description:
Job Title: Senior Executive – Demurrage & Detention

Department: Finance

Reporting To: Manager – Finance


Job Purpose:

The Senior Executive – Demurrage & Detention is responsible for managing, monitoring, and controlling demurrage and detention charges across import and export shipments. The role ensures accurate calculation, timely billing, dispute resolution, cost recovery, and compliance with carrier contracts and internal policies. The position plays a critical role in minimizing financial exposure, protecting margins, and supporting operational efficiency within the shipping agency.


Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

Demurrage & Detention Management

  • Monitor demurrage and detention exposure for all import and export shipments.
  • Calculate demurrage and detention charges accurately as per carrier tariffs, contracts, and free-time agreements.
  • Coordinate closely with Operations and Documentation teams to track container movements and free-time utilization.
  • Ensure timely issuance and follow-up of demurrage and detention invoices to customers.


Dispute Resolution & Recovery

  • Handle demurrage and detention disputes with customers, terminals, and carriers.
  • Prepare and submit waiver, extension, or reduction requests supported by proper documentation.
  • Follow up on approvals, settlements, and recoveries to minimize financial losses.
  • Maintain detailed records of disputed and approved cases for audit and reporting.


Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare periodic demurrage and detention reports highlighting exposure, recoveries, and outstanding risks.
  • Analyze root causes of high demurrage and detention costs and propose corrective actions.
  • Share insights with management to improve operational planning and container turnaround.


Compliance & Controls

  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, approval matrices, and contractual terms.
  • Maintain accurate documentation for audit readiness and management review.
  • Ensure adherence to Brazilian regulatory and documentation requirements related to invoicing and collections.


Stakeholder Coordination

  • Coordinate with internal teams (Operations, Finance, Customer Service, Commercial) for issue resolution.
  • Communicate professionally with customers, carriers, terminals, and depots regarding charges and disputes.
  • Support management initiatives to reduce long-stayed containers and operational inefficiencies.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Reduction in demurrage and detention costs through proactive management and recovery – 30%
  • Timely and accurate calculation and billing of demurrage and detention charges – 25%
  • Successful resolution and recovery of disputed demurrage and detention cases – 20%
  • Timely submission of reports and visibility on exposure and risks – 15%
  • Compliance with internal controls, contracts, and audit requirements – 10%


Key Interactions:

Internal: Operations, Documentation, Finance, Customer Service, Commercial

External: Customers, Shipping Lines, Terminals, Depots, Auditors (as required)


Core Competencies (Grade D – Professional Level):

  • Integrity & Accountability: Ensures accuracy, transparency, and ethical handling of financial exposures.
  • Customer Focus: Balances customer relationships with cost recovery and contractual compliance.
  • Continuous Learning: Keeps updated on carrier tariffs, free-time rules, and operational practices.
  • Agility: Responds effectively to operational challenges and tight deadlines.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Works closely with cross-functional teams to resolve issues.


Functional Competencies (Grade D – Professional Level):

  • Demurrage & Detention Expertise: Strong understanding of free time, tariffs, and carrier contracts.
  • Dispute & Claims Management: Ability to manage negotiations and documentation for charge reductions.
  • Operational Coordination: Works with operations to reduce container dwell time.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Interprets exposure data to support decision-making.
  • ERP & Operational Systems: Proficient in shipping and accounting systems used for tracking charges.
  • Attention to Detail: Ensures accuracy in calculations, documentation, and reporting.


Education and Experience Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Shipping, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.


Experience:

  • 4–6 years of experience in demurrage and detention management within a shipping agency or logistics environment.
  • Strong exposure to import/export operations and container lifecycle management.
  • Experience dealing with carriers, terminals, and depots.
  • Experience in shipping, liner agency, or freight forwarding operations preferred.
  • Portuguese – Fluent (required).
  • English – Fluent (required).


Work Environment and Specific Requirements:

  • Office-based role with close coordination with operations and finance teams.
  • Requires high attention to detail, strong follow-up, and negotiation skills.
  • May require extended working hours during peak operational periods or vessel delays.
  • Reports directly to the Manager – Operations/ Finance for task allocation and performance review.

title: Lead developer
description:
ADP is hiring a Lead Developer


You will start your day on a scrum call to sync up the sprint work and goal with your team. You will spend most of your day designing, developing and testing your code and supporting your team members. You will be able to deploy your code in production using automated continuous integration and continuous deployment.

You will work with product managers, analysts, architects, and engineers to plan, design, develop, test, and implement information technology solutions.


Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:


  • We'll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, ID any issues, and communicate coding priorities.
  • Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and good coding standards. Your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time.
  • We don't code in a silo. You'll talk to everyone from the project manager to Quality Assurance and current customers to understand requirements and create a collaborative output.
  • We're always learning new codes and investigating open-source communities. Knowing what questions to ask is more important than knowing the right answers.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:


  • Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience on web application development.
  • Advanced understanding development using JavaScript frameworks.
  • Advanced English
  • Experience with Java;
  • Know best practices around software development, SDLC, unit testing, frontend performance tuning, be able to share this knowledge with others in the team.
  • Experience using CI and CD pipelines
  • Technical Analysis – analyzing systems, problems, programs, formulating solutions.
  • Technical Design – ensuring that all work undertaken is of sound design and fits in with the existing architecture.
  • Participates in requirements gathering and reviews, assesses technical feasibility, assists in defining solutions, and prepares development artifacts where required.
  • Conducts code walk through and reviews with team members.
  • Monitors changes in technology; remains up to date on current industry trends and internal architecture practices, principles, models and standards; trains technical staff on new technologies.


HOW YOU’LL STAND OUT:


  • Nice to have, develop frontend framework for other teams
  • Develop frontend web applications in NodeJS and React
  • Support production software operations, test and debug programs
  • Make a good use of the CI and CD pipeline
  • Self-taught worker: capable of learning and applying by himself
  • Self-guided worker: capable of working with different product teams with little supervision after the initial learning period
  • Strong collaboration skills: ability to establish good relationships with the stakeholders
  • Developer empathy: ability to empathize with developers, by being flexible in solution design without compromising best practices and standards.
  • Improvisation (lateral thinking): the ability to think across disciplines and existing boundaries (technologies/business/geographies)
  • Research: an inclination to continuous research inside and outside of the current focus fields.


*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.
